runtimeWitness.rule: the candidate must launch a TileLang-generated kernel and must not launch the vendor fusion operator

precision.rule: P1 e_cand <= 3.0*e_ref + max(1.0*2**-8, 2**-17); P2 max_rel_cand <= max(2**-7, 1.5*max_rel_ref)

64x4096.why: 30 quiet window(s) of 45 (66.7%) is not an unbiased sample: 9 and 70% are both required, because the windows excluded for contention are excluded systematically, not at random

witnessSamplingRateHz.note: npu-smi costs 0.5-3.2 s per invocation on this host, so this rate is bounded by the tool, not by choice. It is reported so a sparse "quiet" cannot be mistaken for an observed one.
